title: Calendar: the week grid stays where you scroll it, and an event's editor opens beside it
steps: ⌘⇧P, Open calendar, then Week. Swipe or scroll sideways back past three weeks, then on past three weeks: it stops on the week you scrolled to each time, and doesn't jump or keep loading.
Open Meeting prep and click an event chip: the calendar opens on that event's week, with its editor right beside it, all of it on screen.
